title: China Launches AI Math Alliance With 1,000 Scientists
summary:
Leading mathematicians in Beijing convened on Sunday to establish a coordinated effort to utilize machine learning for theoretical research. The initiative incorporates 8 institutions and seeks to recruit more than 1,000 scientists into a network dedicated to automating mathematical discovery.

The group focuses on building specialized AI models capable of generating new conjectures and formalizing proofs. Members also intend to develop systems with reasoning processes that are more easily interpreted by humans to ensure the validity of the AI generated output.
